title: Question about calibration
body:
Please, help. 

Does the last calibration on certain BG affect on different BG sensor data/values which were calibrated previosly?

If yes, this means that last calibration "shifts" all BG data/values (even that were calibrated previosly), and there's "subquestion":

What's the point of calibrating sensor on different BGs?

Thanks.
